title: HAZOP deviation: loss of flow on pump discharge
description: P-101 is running and delivering flow to V-102. Investigate an unplanned loss-of-flow event: acknowledge the alarm, inspect the equipment, identify the cause, and restore flow safely.
learningObjectives: Apply the HAZOP guide word 'No' (no flow) to a pump discharge line.
Use alarms and instrument readings to investigate a process deviation.
Take the correct corrective action (clear the trip, then restart) rather than guessing.

events.description: P-101 has tripped unexpectedly — investigate the loss of flow (HAZOP guide word: No).

tasks.text: Notice and acknowledge the low-flow alarm (FAL-101) within 60 seconds of it activating.
Identify the cause, clear the trip, and restore discharge flow (FT-101 > 2) within 4 minutes.

completionFeedback.onPass: You correctly diagnosed the loss of flow as a pump trip, cleared it, and restored the discharge flow.
completionFeedback.onFail: Flow was not restored in time. Remember: a tripped pump must be cleared at the local panel before it can be restarted.

safetyConstraints: Do not attempt to restart the pump before clearing the trip — the simulator will block the start and log the reason.
